items.title: Producing algebraic independence from a codimension two component condition
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a finitely generated domain over a field and elements whose common vanishing locus has a component of codimension two, the lemma produces coefficients in the field such that a displayed list of elements in the rational function field is algebraically independent. The proof analyses the dimension of the vanishing locus to force the required independence, choosing the coefficients generically so that the associated polynomial relation cannot occur. Converting the codimension hypothesis into algebraic independence by a generic choice of coefficients is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 9024-9052.
